selectedAssumptions.status: Agent-selected design scenarios, NOT observations of the existing house
selectedAssumptions.jurisdictionForPreliminaryChecks: Russian Federation; to verify before site design

building.ceiling: Timber confirmed; no protective construction evidenced, treated as unprotected. Bags with sawdust/coal around or above them are reported; exact composition and layer thickness unknown. Cold ventilated space above remains a thermal assumption, not a confirmed attic survey.
building.floor: Floor above a cold ventilated crawlspace, not a ground-bearing slab
building.geometryNote: 6x10 m is an equivalent simplified thermal perimeter, not a measured room or wall plan.

use.heatingRole: Primary heating sought, not demonstrated by the current stove model
use.roomHeatDistribution: Unverified; the whole-house sum is not proof that closed rooms reach +20 C
use.stoveType: Russian cooking chamber with separate hob retained as a design requirement
use.wood: Seasoned firewood; no burn rate or permissible fuel charge assigned

installation.ceilingClearanceCondition: SP 7.13130.2013 section 5.18: periodic masonry stove with three-course cap below an unprotected combustible ceiling; not a chimney penetration clearance
installation.foundation: Selected concept: one new reinforced-concrete foundation supporting stove plus rooted masonry chimney, structurally separated from the house foundation. Soil bearing, depth, dimensions and reinforcement are engineering outputs.
installation.chimney: Selected concept: new vertical rooted clay-brick chimney with accessible cleaning, carried by the stove/chimney foundation. Bore, terminal height, stability and penetration details remain engineering outputs.
installation.combustibleFillAtPenetration: No bags, sawdust or coal retained within the designed noncombustible penetration zone; remaining loose fill must be restrained from spilling into it. A coal/slag substitution is not inferred from the user's wording.

thermalMethod.boundaryTemperature: Outdoor temperature applied to walls, ceiling and exposed floor in all three scenarios; no ground-temperature model
thermalMethod.gains: No credit for sun, occupants or appliances
thermalMethod.airExchange: Equivalent outdoor air rate without heat recovery; includes the scenario's ventilation/infiltration, not a prescribed ventilation design. Combustion air and extractor operation are not sized.
thermalMethod.uValues: Chosen whole-element U-values W/(m2 K), not inferred actual wall materials or code compliance. The reported sawdust/coal does NOT establish the assumed ceiling U=0.30 or verify the 6.93 kW scenario.
thermalMethod.thermalBridges: Explicit scenario allowance W/K, not a measured value, normative percentage or hidden output margin

thermalScenarios.label: Weaker assumed envelope and higher outdoor air exchange

note: The user authorized selection of assumptions. The missing entries remain unknown SITE FACTS, not unanswered preferences blocking preliminary work. See thermal-scenarios.json for computed loads. Actual house load, foundation and chimney construction remain unverified.
